content: Your pain is the breaking of the shell that encloses your understanding.
author: Kahlil Gibran
explanation: Gibran compares emotional sorrow to the hard outer husk of a seed that must crack open for the living blossom to emerge. Suffering is not a senseless penalty; it is the crucible that expands our capacity for compassion and wisdom.
practicalInsight: When feeling heartache or grief today, view the pain as an expansion of your emotional depth rather than a defeat.
reflectionPrompt: What deep sorrow in your past cracked open a level of empathy and understanding you previously lacked?
